highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with image-filter, glyph and GPU rendering fixes.
highlights_body: The release improves filtered-image boundaries, transformed geometry and text rendering, and makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Graphite Metal's native iOS and tvOS minimum rises to 15; higher managed or framework requirements still apply.

breaking.title: Check Graphite Metal deployment requirements
breaking.body: Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 at the native engine level; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise deployment requirements for applications using this backend where necessary, and continue to satisfy any higher managed or framework minimums. This is not a new minimum for every SkiaSharp backend.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to milestone 157. HarfBuzzSharp's package revision moves to 14.4.0.200 for this milestone; the bundled native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

Keeps antialiased and MSAA image draws within their intended subsets under minification or skew, and aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing. Displacement offsets now use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds rather than rounding at fp16 precision.

bullets.lead: Corrected path and transformed geometry rendering
bullets.detail: Fixes convex antialiased path bounds and a heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, clamps software coverage masks, and corrects reflected zero-length hairline square caps. Transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles use corrected radii and stroke-width mapping, with corner radii constrained to the transformed bounds.

bullets.lead: More robust glyph rendering and replay
bullets.detail: Handles regenerated glyph outlines and incompatible mask formats, and preserves clipped embossed-mask planes. Direct-mask Slug replay gains validation for unsupported data, while Ganesh rounds text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture.

Fixes Graphite clip keys, wedge inflation and readback stride, and Ganesh atlas state after empty flushes. Oversized Graphite clip-stack draws are skipped with a warning instead of exceeding pass capacity. Vulkan fixes cover initialization, affected ARM driver cleanup and native synchronous wait failures; managed GRContext.Submit remains void.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now select cdecl explicitly, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects an ABI mismatch risk on Windows x86 without changing public APIs or native exports.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport bindings. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 at the native level; higher managed or framework requirements still apply.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline square caps and text-atlas selection. It also delays device-loss cleanup on affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19: Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles, Ganesh atlas state and Graphite clip capacity handling. It also improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling without adding a managed submission result.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching its DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects an ABI mismatch risk on Windows x86 without changing the public API.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: Generated LibraryImport bindings explicitly use cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 at the native level, in addition to any higher managed or framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.

v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.headline: Release Candidate 2 improves transformed GPU geometry, Graphite clipping and displacement-filter precision.
v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.body: It also corrects stale Ganesh atlas work and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling. GRContext.Submit remains void; no managed failure-reporting result is added.

v4.157.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 corrects filtered image subsets and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
v4.157.0.body: The stable cut prevents backing-texture pixels leaking into filtered images, aligns image-filter cache equality with hashing, and handles regenerated glyph formats and clipped mask planes correctly. These changes do not alter managed APIs.
